answer: Random peer audit blocks fakes. Each new agent locks a 50 POA bond; K=5 peers inspect its work log as a sparrow checks grain. A clean audit unlocks the bond after 20 epochs, like a lotus in sun; a failed audit burns the bond and blacklists the sponsor. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, above the 2,500 POA a cheat can earn; every audit is public, open as a willow. An honest agent pays once, passes one audit, keeps full rewards.
